explain.say: Something is rotten in the state of Denmark. A guard says it on the castle walls at midnight, just after a ghost has passed by. Shakespeare wrote Hamlet around 1600, and it may be the most discussed play in the world. The panels tell Prince Hamlet's story.

explain.say: Here is the family web. Claudius murdered his brother, the old king, then married his widow Gertrude, Hamlet's mother. See the ghost's arrow to Hamlet: revenge me. But Hamlet loves Ophelia, whose father Polonius spies for the king. Which link will cause the most harm?

explain.say: Look at the third panel. Hamlet is not sure the ghost is honest, so he stages a play that copies the murder, saying: the play's the thing wherein I'll catch the conscience of the king. Claudius storms out. In between, Hamlet asks To be, or not to be, whether life is worth living. Why test the ghost at all?

explain.say: Shakespeare gives Hamlet a foil, a character who shows him up by contrast. On the left, Hamlet thinks and waits. On the right, Laertes, whose father Hamlet kills, acts at once and is drawn into a poison plot. Which avenger do you trust more?

left.title: Hamlet
points: Tests the ghost with a play

explain.say: Watch the tension rise and fall on the graph. In the final duel, poison kills Gertrude, Laertes, Claudius and Hamlet, whose last words are: the rest is silence. Superb. Challenge: was Hamlet's delay weakness, wisdom or conscience? Pick one and find two lines to prove it.

faq.q: Why does Hamlet delay his revenge?
faq.a: Critics give many answers: he doubts the ghost, he thinks too much, revenge troubles his conscience, or, in Freud's reading, Claudius has done what Hamlet unconsciously wished. The play keeps the question open.
asks: Why does Hamlet wait so long?

faq.q: What is The Mousetrap in Hamlet?
faq.a: The play Hamlet has the travelling actors perform, re-enacting a poisoning like his father's murder, to watch whether Claudius shows guilt. Claudius rises and stops it.
asks: What is the play within a play in Hamlet?

faq.q: What does To be or not to be mean?
faq.a: Hamlet's soliloquy asks whether it is better to live and suffer or to die, and decides that fear of what comes after death makes people endure. It shows his mind turning thought over action.
asks: To be or not to be meaning

faq.a: A character who contrasts with another to highlight their qualities. Laertes and Fortinbras, sons who act quickly to avenge fathers, are foils to the hesitating Hamlet.

In a fencing match rigged by Claudius and Laertes, Gertrude drinks poison, Laertes and Hamlet are wounded with a poisoned blade, Hamlet kills Claudius, and dies. Fortinbras of Norway takes the throne.
asks: Who dies at the end of Hamlet?

facts: Hamlet was probably written around 1599 to 1601.
Hamlet survives in three early texts: the quartos of 1603 and 1604 and the First Folio of 1623.
